outcome: Give managing partner / delivery excellence head a governed method to improve proposal first-draft cycle time using approved references, RFP questions and service collateral, with final decisions…
overview: Proposal Response Evidence Library addresses operational records arrive through different systems, supervisors reconstruct evidence manually, and decisions are difficult to audit in professional services operations. The first proof of value uses approved references, RFP questions and service collateral. It produces a reviewed operational recommendation and a traceable decision record. The commercial success measure is proposal first-draft cycle time, established from customer baseline data before any improvement is claimed.

scope:
Delivery model: Redington or approved implementation partner, eligibility and staffing pending confirmation.
Duration: Discovery and design first; pilot and rollout durations depend on data access and scope; no fixed commitment.
1) Discover source quality and baseline: approved references, RFP questions and service collateral; define proposal first-draft cycle time and data-processing boundary.
2) Design control points, security and connector contracts; obtain owner approval from Managing Partner / Delivery Excellence Head.
3) Implement one bounded workflow, instrument missing-data exceptions and system-of-record write-back.
4) Test positive, negative, privilege, partial-data and rollback cases including line-by-line reconciliations against known business transactions.
5) Review KPI in the pilot, document evidence, perform training and agree transition.
deliverables: Agreed test threshold for proposal first-draft cycle time
